In the file "Screenshot 2026-09-06 at 16.07.59.png" that you shared, the /rc in the bottom right corner is a built-in slash command for Claude Code.
It is an alias for the /remote-control command.
Here is what it does:
•	Mobile & Web Handoff: Running /rc enables the Remote Control feature, which connects your live, local terminal session to the Claude mobile app or claude.ai/code.
•	Local Execution, Remote Steering: This allows you to step away from your computer and continue to monitor, steer, or respond to the agent from your phone or another browser. Meanwhile, the actual code execution and filesystem access stay safely on your local machine.
•	Easy Pairing: When you trigger /rc, Claude Code will provide a link and an option to display a QR code so you can quickly pair the session with your remote device.
